title: Separate local Test Runs placement from named-root attribution and check credit
outcome: Keep local invocation, execution location and supported check facts visible for attributable execution while preventing display-only placement or a withheld opening from conferring authority.
acceptance: Direct and delayed observations handle supported explicit execution location, including eligible linked worktrees, while leaving proof worktree, work binding and verification authority empty when source attribution is unconfirmed.

Declared artifact verdicts use the original execution and proven command-start inputs. Missing placement or unproved start artifact yields an explicit indeterminate result where expected. Registered launcher correlation and eligible committed-input verification keep their existing exact authority.

Deterministic cases exercise off-root, unavailable/ambiguous cwd, direct and delayed linked declaration recognition, and independent launcher association. Coordinate the shared helper with 5C8B before overlapping edits.
